params.name: PageSize
params.description: How many resources to return in each list page. The default is 50, and the maximum is 1000.

params.name: Page
params.description: The page index. This value is simply for client state.

params.name: PageToken
params.description: The page token. This is provided by the API.

params.name: IsoCountry
params.description: The [ISO country code](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_3166-1_alpha-2) of the origin-based voice pricing information to fetch.

params.name: DestinationNumber
params.description: The destination phone number, in [E.164](https://www.twilio.com/docs/glossary/what-e164) format, for which to fetch the origin-based voice pricing information. E.164 format consists of a + followed by the country code and subscriber number.

params.name: OriginationNumber
params.description: The origination phone number, in [E.164](https://www.twilio.com/docs/glossary/what-e164) format, for which to fetch the origin-based voice pricing information. E.164 format consists of a + followed by the country code and subscriber number.

items.docs: Fetch pricing information for a specific destination and, optionally, origination phone number.
